main_text.l: 9. Ipse Agnus ab origine mundi mactatus carnem suam pro mundi vita dedit, ejusq; mortis virtus pervenit ad eos etiam, qui ante ipsius incarnationem vixerunt.
10. Ipsius obedientia J u s t i constituimur, quatenus illa nobis per fidê ad justitiam imputatur.
11. Ipse à Deo nobis SERVATOR datus, nos maledictos peccatores justi-tiæ Dei, punitionem ob peccata requirenti, suâ morte satisfaciendo, sal-vos fecit.

12. Ipse denique ex patris decreto morti traditus est, non quod ipse esset peccator, sed HOSTIA pro peccato nostro, & SPONSOR pro nobis peccatoribus, & ita moriendo pro peccatis nostris satisfecit. Huic nostro Sponsori & sponso sit gloria & honor in omnem seculorū omni-um sempiternitatem, Amen.

page.notes: The ornamental device between the text and the signature is a printer's ornament, not text, so it is not transcribed. The handwritten "307" in the upper right margin is not printed and is left out. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at lower left and lower right and is left out. The page number "11" at top right is read from a worn print and is not fully certain. The word "suâ" in paragraph 11 is read from a worn print with some doubt.
